name: Survey tile in Scorpius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Scorpius, imaged by SPHEREx 21 times in 8 visits over 69 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 41 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2025-08-11, at wavelengths from 0.77 to 4.15 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
